description: Set the auto-tolerance flag for geometric manipulations. When auto-tolerance flag is on , any geometric manipulation of building blocks/faces/edges/points will update the tolerance with the value that is average length of all edges × \(10^{-8}\) . The tolerance update will happen before validation of all affected blocks. In the 9.x series the official keyword is 'automatic-tolerance'; the legacy 'auto-tolerance' spelling is still accepted by FLAC3D 9.7.
